title: Lapse and reasonable time
summary: An unstated acceptance period is measured in the transaction’s circumstances.
notes: A face-to-face offer ordinarily ends with the conversation, as the Akers discussion illustrates. Rapid changes in market price can shorten reasonable time. Loring’s reward responded to a past emergency, whereas Carr’s reward concerned possible future crimes. The settlement-countdown problem varies procedural circumstances and the timing of acceptance. A later unfavorable verdict does not itself supply an agreed expiration term.
